nanguan.quote: 南音，原稱絃管，亦稱南管、南乐、南曲、郎君樂等
also nanyin, nanyue, xianguan, or nanqu
典型的編制為琵琶、三絃、洞簫、二絃、拍(板)，合稱上四管
其特有的橫抱彈奏，猶存於弦管琵琶
a crooked-neck lute played horizontally called the pipa
sung in Quanzhou dialect, either by a sole singer who also plays clappers
樂曲開頭多以彈撥樂器撚指起音，而後洞簫等樂器隨之溶入合奏
The gî-pê provides a steady rhythmic skeleton, supported by the sam-hiân.
It is typically slow, gentle, delicate and melodic, heterophonic and employing four basic scales.
nanguan.note: The English article carries a December 2025 warning that it appears to include text from a language model; used only where the Chinese article or UNESCO says the same.

nanguan.quote: The slow, simple and elegant melodies are performed on distinctive instruments such as a bamboo flute called the dongxiao
曲目主要有指、譜、曲三大類別
is a style of Chinese chamber music from the southern Chinese province of Fujian
是一個絲竹樂種
nanguan.note: A silk-and-bamboo genre, like jiangnansizhu, which sits in chineseclass.

nanguan.quote: 現存最早的弦管曲簿，為明代的兩個刊本
不少名曲在四百多年前就已盛行
弦管的歷史淵源，可追溯到漢代的相和歌
nanguan.note: Claimed ancestry, not a first record of the genre itself.

nanguan.quote: 發源於古代泉州
Nanyin is a musical performing art central to the culture of the people of Minnan in southern Fujian Province
現今流傳於中國的廈門、泉州、漳州，以及臺灣、東南亞的菲律賓、新加坡、馬來西亞、印度尼西亞等地
It is the sound of the motherland for Minnan people in China and throughout South-East Asia.
東南亞的菲律賓或馬來西亞的華人社會， 則習慣地稱為南樂
During the early twentieth century, Nanguan reached its peak popularity in Taiwan, with more than sixty Nanguan associations established across the island.
nanguan.note: From the section of the English article flagged for language-model text; its source is an NTU thesis (Yang 2015) not read here.

nanguan.quote: By the 1970s, many Nanguan associations had disappeared
1982年，臺南南聲社受邀至歐洲巡演
此次的巡演成功，在媒體報導和學者為文引介下，掀起了臺灣的弦管熱潮
湘靈音樂社成立於1940年，是新加坡目前最主要的南音團體
nanguan.note: Inside a reference note quoting Sun Xingqun 1996.

nanguan.quote: 1961年12月，前往菲律賓五十九天
nanguan.note: Inside a reference note quoting Lü Yuxiu 2003: Nansheng She tour of the Philippines.

nanguan.quote: There are two nanguan associations in Singapore
泉廈地區則至文革結束後開始復辦南音
2006年5月20日，泉州的南音被列進中華人民共和國國務院公布的第一批國家級非物質文化遺產名錄
2009年9月30日申報成功
弦管體現了古代雅樂的審美思想
與弦管關係密切的清樂大曲，是唐代各種大曲的根基
在臺灣，與具有北方特色的北管相對
has influenced opera, puppet theatre and other performing art traditions
數量多達數千首，謂之「詞山曲海」
指套目前共四十八套
大譜目前共十六套
two thousand pieces exist in manuscript
蔡小月（1941年—），南管演唱家（曲腳），南聲社成員
弦管音樂家王心心彈奏弦管琵琶
